handbookNote: Utah Real Estate Principal Broker license exam. First state of the second wave of the 2026-09-02 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order re-verified live: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: Pearson VUE, under contract with the Utah Division of Real Estate (DRE). Exam mechanics confirmed directly from Pearson VUE's own official, current PDFs (fetched and text-extracted via pdftotext after WebFetch failed on the compressed PDF streams): the Content Outline for Utah Broker Licensing Examinations (#094502, effective 04/2025, national portion) and the Utah Real Estate Candidate Handbook (state portion + exam-day logistics + passing scores). National/general portion: 80 scored items (+5 pretest, unscored). Utah state portion: 90 scored items (+5-10 pretest, unscored). Total 170 scored items. Duration: 4 hours (240 min) -- stated directly in the handbook as the flat exam-day time allotment, not broken out per national/state sub-portion. Passing score: a SCALED score of 75 (both the national and state sub-scores use the same scaled 75 threshold) -- the handbook explicitly states this is a proprietary scaled score (0-100), not literally the number or percentage of questions answered correctly (Utah's own salesperson exam uses a scaled 70 by the same mechanism). track_registry models this as exam_question_count=170, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=128 (round(170*0.75)), consistent with this site's existing practice-approximation convention for scaled-score states. NATIONAL PORTION (80 items) uses Pearson VUE's own real, confirmed 8-section template (matches the structure independently confirmed this session for AL/WI/LA, though per-state item weights differ) -- exact Utah Broker weights per section, all confirmed directly from the outline PDF: I. Real Property Characteristics, Legal Descriptions, and Property Use (10), II. Forms of Ownership, Transfer, and Recording of Title (8), III. Property Value and Appraisal (10), IV. Real Estate Contracts and Agency (15), V. Real Estate Practice (12), VI. Property Disclosures and Environmental Issues (9), VII. Financing and Settlement (8), VIII. Real Estate Math Calculations (8) -- sums to the stated 80. UTAH STATE PORTION (90 items) drafted against the real Utah-specific outline, using the outline's own stated ranges (midpoint used for drafting-volume guidance, not a hard per-topic ceiling): I. Definitions (5-7), II. Licensing (15-17), III. Licensee Practice (33-35, the largest section by far -- covers licensee conduct, commissions/affiliation, discharge of associated licensees, administrative procedures, and approved forms including the Real Estate Purchase Contract), IV. Disciplinary Action (9-11), V. Real Estate Recovery Fund (2-3), VI. Additional Utah State Topics (8-10 -- a real, named grab-bag of Utah-specific statutes: fractionalized long-term estate sales, the Timeshare and Camp Resort Act, water rights, mechanic's/construction liens, the Utah Residence Restriction and Lien Recovery Fund, property taxes, foreclosure, the Sex Offender Registry Act, and stigmatized-property disclosure law), VII. Property Management (4-6), VIII. Closing Statements (6-8). This bank was drafted across 16 parallel single-topic drafting passes (8 national Pearson VUE sections + 8 Utah state-law sections), each instructed to draft as many genuinely distinct, real, grounded questions as its topic's real source material supports, with no target number or ceiling. Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
